entries.3b3b6322c65adeae: This business delivers evening meal ingredients and sells food for business use. Home delivery of evening meal ingredients is provided to general households in Aichi, Gifu and Mie Prefectures in the Chubu region, and in parts of Kyoto, Osaka and Shiga Prefectures in the Kansai region. It uses an integrated delivery system in which products are manufactured at the company's own factories and sold and delivered by sales staff, and it also conducts food research and product development. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥5,512 million for menu products and ¥495 million for special-offer products.
entries.54bf7f92b96224d5: A food delivery company that manufactures dinner ingredient kits and similar products at its own factories, and has sales staff deliver them directly to ordinary households.
entries.6c6d4883d3f47ab1: This business sells food products to nursing care facilities and serviced housing for the elderly, and also provides wholesale to businesses such as other retailers. It also provides menu planning and other services, as well as management guidance, to franchise member companies.

entries.d3050cef29005ea3: The company is headquartered in Moriyama-ku, Nagoya. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 349, and the company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Main Market of the Nagoya Stock Exchange. Its business consists of a single segment, Food Business. Its parent company is Shinmei Holdings Co., Ltd., which held 50.54% of voting rights as of March 31, 2026.
